corpus: AAPM 2016 LDCT grand challenge, held-out test (4 patients), 1mm B30, FD vs QD real pairing

protocol.fidelity: PSNR/SSIM on the shared 48-slice detection subset per patient (192 slices total); full-volume r=0.25 values in aapm_r3_roi_detectability.json (R3)
protocol.detectability: freq-ROI detectability-freq-v1 (ROI BandER + full BandER + ROI tm_auc, same 48 slices)
protocol.transparency: CNR/CHO/NPWE insertion protocol on 32 slices x 16 trials
protocol.knee: detectability knee = dose ratio where ROI BandER first reaches 0.5 (linear interpolation); CNR Rose-crossing reported for transparency (all CNR<3 on real data per v2/R3)
